$comment: Runtime settings. teamId is your FPL entry ID - the number in your fantasy.premierleague.com
URL (.../entry/<teamId>/event/<gw>). Leave it null and squad-dependent commands will tell you
what to set rather than guessing. Copy this file to config/local.app.json to override locally
without touching version control (config/local.*.json is gitignored).

staleness.$comment: Warn loudly if a recommendation is being generated from data older than this.
